newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cylink cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cylink cut to hold.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said analyst Gibbs Moody downgraded Cylink Corp to hold from buy.
-- said new management has "embarked on a path" of more sales and marketing expenses and possibly more spending in research and development.

-- said operating income growth could defy analysis for the next two or three quarters and may produce results below Wall Street expectations "since the new management is not able to give guidance on when investors can expect to see the financial benefit of these new investments.
